segments.summary: Reviewed F3-413 through F3-416 line-by-line: GUI-first terminal control, rich-text fidelity, UI hard gates, and bounded projection stores have clear intent, but their action inventory, fixture oracles, gate lifecycle, and per-store budget algorithms leave material test and recovery gaps.

Reviewed the full F3-417 and F3-418 semantic window line-by-line, including platform, renderer, web authority, icon, CTA, navigation, restore, lineage, and Usage propagation contracts. Strong negative constraints coexist with missing lifecycle, precedence, failure, and data-authority rules.
